result.brief: 提出两阶段 Priming Models：先以重建目标（固定噪声去噪）预训练，再做特征空间分布后训练，实现简单高效的一步生成，并在图像生成与世界模型任务上验证。
result.reason: Two-stage one-step generator with reconstruction priming then feature-space distributional training; evaluated on world modeling and image generation, relevant to generative latent/representation training.
